files.release_edits: build-release.ps1 sets DriverVer to the release version and adds the Reboot directive to each install section
files.role: KMD 0.7.216.14 INF (bc250-win a00da18c, train/b22). BD-091: every setting this INF writes is now the released value of tools/release/installer/registry-defaults.json, and it carries NOCLOBBER (flags 0x00010003), so a driver update that the installer does not drive gets the released configuration on a fresh computer and leaves an existing value alone. Until 0.7.216.3 the INF wrote 0 into each Enable* gate and named EnableNativeSmu nowhere, so such an update asked for the SMU owner with no register mapping and the start failed with Code 43. The gate tools/quality/inf_gates.py compares the packaged INF with the defaults table at every release build. Two Parameters values keep the old unconditional write on purpose and each says why at its line: UnconfirmedStarts, because installing the package grants a fresh start budget, and EnableHangBugcheck, because installing a package must disarm a test bugcheck that somebody left armed. EnableMmioWrite and HwmonBasePort carry NOCLOBBER but stand outside the defaults table (inf_gates.py NOT_IN_TABLE): a computer that never had this driver gets the closed value, and an operator's own value survives a reinstall. The memory manager stage 1 switches (ApertureSegmentMegabytes, EnableSharedResidency) are absent on purpose, because a value the INF never writes is one a driver update can never reset. The release re-stamps DriverVer and adds the Reboot directive

KMD 0.7.216.14, escape ABI 0x000700D8, unchanged from 0.7.216.1 (bc250-win a00da18c, train/b22: the tester.19 driver 0.7.216.1 with the b22 kernel wagons). New in b22, each one a Parameters value away from the behaviour before it. A runtime restart of the GPU device inside a confirmed boot works: an orderly stop gives the boot-loop guard its start back, a second teardown of the same device is refused by a StopDone guard instead of running twice, the release of the display fills the scanned-out surface with black, and CreateDevice logs the process it answered (BD-090). The DisplayPort audio path reads the Azalia, DIO and DCCG state for the check table and clears DIO_MEM_PWR_CTRL before it enables the stream, as Linux dcn201_init_hw does. The clock governor holds its idle point while the work on the GPU still fits that point (DpmIdleLeavePermille 150), which stops the 500 and 1000 MHz flapping of an idle desktop, and it carries the C62 joint power arm that caps the processor for a bound and hot GPU, behind DpmJointGovernor, which is 0 in this release. Memory manager stage 1: the OS aperture is 384 MiB (ApertureSegmentMegabytes, absent = 384, clamped to 256..447, one fallback to 256 if the GART refuses), a VRAM allocation of the user-mode driver that is neither a scan-out surface nor DISCARDABLE is also resident in the aperture segment so Windows can move it to system memory instead of evicting it (EnableSharedResidency, absent = 1), and the vidmm and paging counters now report what moved. The SMU owner is refused with a log line instead of a failed start when BAR5 is not mapped, and the log ring is kept in one file per device start and per stop under C:/BC250/kmdlog, with 200-file pruning (BD-091). The kernel is built with /Brepro and a sorted object list, and two builds of this head into empty directories gave the same unsigned and signed bytes. The b21 changes against 0.7.213.1 are all here too, each on by every install with one Parameters value that takes it away again. A VMID per page-table root from a pool of up to 14, so a job of another process does not wait for the ring to drain (EnableVmidPool, 0.7.214). The case fan control: the driver takes fan 1 from the BIOS curve while it runs, drives it on its own curve (Standard: 100 % from 80 C) and gives it back to the chip on every exit path, through escape 30 RUN_FAN (EnableFanControl); a leased mode ends with the durable mode from before it. DisplayPort audio steps 0 to 2: the Azalia endpoint of the running DP stream is configured, the audio stream of that DP encoder is started (audio DTO1, AFMT, DP SEC), and only then is the endpoint present to the inbox HD Audio driver, through escape 31 RUN_DPAUDIO ABI 2 (EnableDpAudio, EnableDpAudioEndpoint, EnableDpAudioStream; 0.7.215.1 showed the endpoint with no audio clock, so no sound and video at about 0.7x). The SMU metrics table once a second for the package power, RUN_DPM ABI 3; a 0 mW table is a skipped sample (EnableSmuMetrics). The CPU tuning surface is open by default (CpuTune 1): a change runs only on an administrator's request, as a trial that reverts by itself. Re-signed with the release certificate, code unchanged

D3D12 shell (bc250-win bc1b00a9, train/b20-setup). It sizes its adapter query BC250_SCANOUT_CAPS_TOTAL, so it reaches the kernel's scan-out caps trailer and reads the new scan-out counters; its E26R record is still 16 bytes of version 2, which the compositor's 64-byte version 3 opener refuses, so the D3D12 client half of route C increment 2 is open (M15.14). It makes a shared texture inside a known shape instead of refusing it, and it counts every second create attempt (BD-075). A command queue accepts a wait on a fence and lets the system do the waiting, where the shell before this one lost the device. Every earlier behaviour of the b19 shell is kept: heap import retries the ownership unlock (BD-045), ClearRootArguments records the real values (BD-046), the direct recording entry of engine-ddi is the default (M15.9), and the shell records each start of an application for the Recent page. Built with /Brepro. A rebuild at 9bc5818f (train/b21) gives the same bytes

New in b22: the budget verb, which prints the video-memory budget, the usage and the demoted bytes of one process (by PID or by image name), and vram, which now also prints DedicatedSystemMemorySize and SharedSystemMemorySize, the pool the non-local budget is taken from. Beside the forms of tester.17 it answers fan (state, auto, curve, set, renew: escape 30), dpaudio (the DP audio check table with the stream record: escape 31, RUN_DPAUDIO ABI 2, falling back to ABI 1) and the SMU power reading in dpm and telemetry (RUN_DPM ABI 3, stepping down on a refusal). A cpu trial line names the default window as such. The same bc250kmd_cli.c makes bc250control.dll, and every form of cli-commands.json answers (test-cli-commands.ps1)

H.264 encoder Media Foundation transform (bc250-win 689852a8, train/b20-setup, which carries e52/encoder-perf e4d1f630). The respin does not rebuild it: no commit of the respin touches driver/umd/mft-h264 or the contract headers it includes, so this is the file the tester.14 build staged, and the lab kit of E52 pins it. The encoder holds two pictures at once, it filters a whole picture in one dispatch, and its rate control reads the quantiser the content needs. A client that asks for low latency still gets one picture at a time. BC250_MFT_DEPTH=1, BC250_MFT_DEBLOCK=waves and BC250_MFT_SERIAL_DEBLOCK each select an older part. The conformance sweep is 76 of 76, and 60 of 60 pictures stay bit exact against the inbox decoder. The build matches the hash the wagon recorded
